messages:
alex: Quick sanity check — using embeddings/rerank batch helper in the SDK. Hitting a vector dim mismatch when concatenating results from two models (text-embedding-ada-002 and open-embedding-small). Also seeing intermittent 401s in CI despite REDWOOD_API_KEY set, and Node streaming stops mid-response sometimes. Anyone seen this?

ravi: For dims — embeddings differ by model. You need to normalize to same model, or map via adapter. Which models are you mixing?

alex: We're mixing `open-emb-small-v1` (1536) and `rbw-embed-1024` (1024) because we fallback to cheaper model on bulk. The helper just stacks arrays and fails downstream.

marie: Don't stack mismatched dims. Either 1) force single model per batch, 2) up/down-project with a learned linear layer, or 3) keep separate index shards per dim. Quick patch: make batcher group by embedding_dim before sending to indexer.

ben: +1 to grouping. Our batching util has a `group_by` hook. Example pseudo:
```
function batchByDim(items){
  const groups = {}
  items.forEach(i=>{ groups[i.dim] = groups[i.dim] || []; groups[i.dim].push(i) })
  return Object.values(groups).flatMap(chunkGroups)
}
```

alex: Nice. Any tips for pagination when reranking? I need consistent offsets between embeddings page and rerank results.

ravi: For rerank: 1) fetch embeddings in stable order (cursor-based) 2) pass original ids to reranker, 3) reranker returns score list you merge by id. Avoid relying on array indices. Use `cursor` and `after_id` not page numbers.

alex: Auth 401s — CI job env var set but node SDK still 401s intermittently. Logs show token missing in some requests.

kelsey: Check process.env is loaded in CI container and that long-lived subprocesses don't overwrite env. Also confirm using SDK v1.4+ — older versions leak auth header when retrying.

ci-bot: deploy-bot: ran periodic token rotation 2026-05-02T10:03Z — some runners received rotated token mid-job, causing 401 on retry.

marie: For retries set exponential backoff and don't retry on 401. In Node SDK pass `retryPredicate: (err) => err.status !== 401` or config `retryOn: ['5xx','429']`.

alex: Streaming quirk — Node stream emits 'end' but last token truncated (cut mid-utf8 char). Python client handles fine.

ben: That's probably buffer chunk boundary. Use `TextDecoder` streaming mode or accumulate Uint8Array then decode at end. Example:
```
const decoder = new TextDecoder('utf-8');
let buf = [];
stream.on('data', chunk=> buf.push(chunk));
stream.on('end', ()=> console.log(decoder.decode(Buffer.concat(buf))))
```

marie: Also check `responseType: 'stream'` vs SSE client — SDK wrappers vary. If using SSE, parse events and decode text per `data:` field.

alex: Thanks all — I'll: group batches by dim, switch rerank to id-merge pagination, update retry predicate to avoid 401s, and apply TextDecoder fix. I'll push a draft PR and ping for review.

ravi: ping when PR ready, can help with batching util tests.

kelsey: I'll add a small CI check to ensure env token isn't rotated mid-job (compare token fingerprint). :thumbsup:
